antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 635nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in odontoblast if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Resonance water-lipid: 306 THz (980nm) targeting membrane fluidity, 10^-14s pulses targeting NO_synthase in odontoblast. Study reference: 2025 peer-reviewed paper shows NO modulation at 635nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial ATP_synthase_F0F1 activation.
